p: Ammonites: They were separated from the Moabites by the river Arnon, and after the ten tribes were carried away into captivity, they invaded the country of Gad.
inherit Gad: That is, of the Ammonites.
his cities: Meaning, of the Israelites.
Rabbah of the Ammonites: Which was one of the chief cities of the Ammonites, as were Heshbon and Ai: there was also a city called Heshbon among the Moabites.
valleys: In your plentiful country.
a fear upon thee: Signifying that power and riches cannot prevail when God will execute his judgments.
afterward I will bring again the: In the time of Christ, when the Gentiles will be called.
Teman: Which was a city of Edom, called by the name of Teman Eliphaz's son, who came from Esau.
turn back: The enemies that pretend to flee, will turn back and invade your land, and possess it.
grapegatherers come to thee: Meaning that God would utterly destroy them and not spare one, though the grape gatherers leave some grapes, and thieves seek but till they have enough, Ob 1:5.
fatherless children: The destruction will be so great that there will be none left to take care of the widows and the fatherless.
Behold: I have not spared my own people and how should I pity you?
Bozrah shall become a desolation: Which was a chief city of Edom.
her: That is, Bozrah.
he shall come up like a: That is, Nebuchadnezzar after he has overcome Judah, which is meant by the swelling of Jordan, will come against mount Seir and Edom.
him run away from her: That is, the Israelites whom the Edomites kept as prisoners to hast away from there.
shepherd that will stand before me: The captain and governor of the army meaning Nebuchadnezzar.
of the flock shall draw them: They will not be able to resist his petty captains.
he shall make their habitations desolate: To visit the enemy.
and spread his wings over Bozrah: As Jer 48:40 was said of Moab.
Damascus: Which was the chief city of Syria, by which he means the whole country.
and fear hath seized on her: When she heard the sudden coming of the enemy.
city of praise not left: He speaks this in the person of the king and of them of the country who will wonder to see Damascus the chief city destroyed.
Benhadad: Who was king of Syria, 1Ki 20:26 and had built these palaces which were still called the palaces of Benhadad.
Kedar: Meaning the Arabians, and their borders.
curtains: Because they used to dwell in tents, he names the things that belong to it.
dwell deep: The enemies will dwell in your places.
Arise: He shows that they of Hazor will flee to the Arabians for comfort but that will not help them.
Elam in the beginning of the: That is Persia, so called for Elam the son of Shem.
bow of Elam: Because the Persians were good archers, he shows that the thing in which they put their trust would not profit them.

throne in Elam: I will place Nebuchadnezzar there, and in these prophecies Jeremiah speaks of those countries which would be subdued under the first of those four monarchies of which Daniel makes mention.
in the latter days: This may be referred to the empire of the Persians and Medes after the Chaldeans or to the time of Christ, as in Jer 48:47.
